evidence: Has Wallet label and modifies external signer wallet key management, ScriptPubKeyMan, and PSBT filling across src/wallet/.
rationale: Allows external signer wallets to hold private keys and mutate signer flags, enabling hybrid multisig and MuSig2 setups. Sjors notes this gets out of the way of MuSig2 support and resolves limitations where the external_signer flag 'precludes multisig setups in which we hold a hot key.'
